filters: single human protein + curated inhibitory action, exclude flagged toxin/payload / APP context, detected tumor >= threshold, tumor q<0.05, donor directional consistency >= threshold
mechanism_notes: Toxin patterns and APP are heuristic safety/relevance filters, not evidence of contraindication. Manual biological review REQUIRED. Tumor source tissue epithelial cells may not all be malignant.
phase_notes: Plug-in inferred phase, not observed sampling times; V1 cell-level q is exploratory; per-patient harmonics can be phase-coverage sensitive; centered curves DO NOT show whole baseline expression.
drug_notes: Not a treatment ranking, efficacy, tumor specificity, dosing time, or clinical recommendation; ChEMBL max_phase is across indications, not CRC-specific; mechanisms do not guarantee response.
score_note: Rank percentiles among qualifying target genes (not molecules), non-clipped distribution; score is descriptive prioritization only
